cmp_grace_school.author: Rev. Mary Wanjiku
cmp_grace_school.title: Books and uniforms for 48 children
cmp_grace_school.body: Books and uniforms for the first 48 children were bought from the Eastleigh supplier on 9 October and handed out on Saturday. Receipts are filed with James Karanja, our finance steward, and will appear in the monthly statement. The remaining 36 children are next.

cmp_grace_school.author: Sarah Njeri
cmp_grace_school.title: Lunch every Saturday this month
cmp_grace_school.body: Lunch was served on all four Saturdays in September — 84 plates each week. The kitchen is still funded month to month; this burden would cover the rest of the term.

cmp_redeemer_clinic.author: Dr. Funmi Adebowale
cmp_redeemer_clinic.title: First clinic day: 212 patients seen
cmp_redeemer_clinic.body: Our first clinic day in Makoko saw 212 patients. 61 were referred on for follow-up care, and every referral has a named nurse. Medicines for the next two clinic days have been ordered.

cmp_redeemer_clinic.author: Pastor Tunde Adebayo
cmp_redeemer_clinic.title: Licences confirmed
cmp_redeemer_clinic.body: The Lagos State outreach licence and the pharmacist's supervision letter are both in place. Copies are on file with the church office and available on request.

cmp_andrew_bursary.author: Mrs. Adwoa Boateng
cmp_andrew_bursary.title: Nine students selected
cmp_andrew_bursary.body: The committee met on 6 October and selected nine students for the 2026 intake from 27 applications. Fees for the first five have been paid directly to Osu Presbyterian SHS — never to families — and the school has confirmed receipt.

cmp_allnations_meals.author: Pastor Grace Okoye
cmp_allnations_meals.title: A fuller hall on Wednesdays
cmp_allnations_meals.body: We served 96 meals last Wednesday, up from 70 in August. Auntie Funke's team now cooks for 100, and the food bank in Peckham gives us bread every week at no cost.

cmp_allnations_meals.author: Daniel Okafor
cmp_allnations_meals.title: September accounts
cmp_allnations_meals.body: September's food and gas bills came to £1,184. Every receipt is in the church's ledger and is checked by a second trustee before payment.

cmp_lighthouse_rebuild.author: Engr. Romulo Santos
cmp_lighthouse_rebuild.title: Foundations poured
cmp_lighthouse_rebuild.body: The foundations for the new hall were poured on 10 October after the soil test passed. The roof steel is ordered for November. The site log, with photographs, is kept at the church office.
